verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms https://www.rudderstack.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content describing RudderStack, directly satisfying the story that an agent can be pointed at llms.txt. This is corroborated by dedicated agent-oriented docs (RudderStack MCP) confirming a broader agent-friendly documentation ecosystem. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents successfully consume the llms.txt content, and no evidence of markdown-per-page docs (the .md probe 404'd).
